email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Joe, saw dbt Labs launched dbt Copilot and now has 9,000 companies using dbt every week.

An AI launch and that much usage usually open more enterprise accounts than the team can cover before reps reach them all, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs's enterprise reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
